subgoals.goal_text: Walk through Viridian Forest to reach the north exit
Travel from Route 2 to Pewter City
Enter the Pewter Gym and defeat Brock to earn the Boulder Badge
Travel from Pewter City through Route 3, Mt. Moon, and Route 4 to reach Cerulean City
Catch a Water-type Pokemon in the grass or water surrounding Cerulean City
